title: Introducing Product Updates
body: You can now catch up on **what's new** right from the header. Click the megaphone icon any time to see the latest features, fixes, and announcements.

title: Faster AI investigations
body:
Investigations now **stream results incrementally** and cite the exact telemetry they used, so you can follow the agent's reasoning as it works.

- Lower time-to-first-insight
- Inline evidence for every step

title: Spot savings for EKS
body: Optimize now recommends **Spot-backed node groups** for fault-tolerant EKS workloads, with projected monthly savings per recommendation.

title: Fixed: duplicate Slack alerts on failover
body: Resolved an issue where some Slack alerts were delivered twice during relay failover. No action needed on your end.
